image-search-command.name: Image search
image-search-command.description: Better image search. Your vision model turns the picture into a search query for your normal image engines, and the visitor's browser reorders the results by how close they look to the picture. Each part can be turned off on its own.

transparency.label: Where the image goes
transparency.description: degoog sends the image from the visitor's browser to this server. With Turn images into a search query on, the server passes it straight to the vision model below and doesn't store it. Text engines only see the query the model writes. Engines that search by image get the picture itself, and each one says so in its own settings. Ranking runs in the visitor's browser. This server downloads the ranking model and runtime once from the hosts below, and browsers load them from this instance.

describe.label: Turn images into a search query
describe.description: Your vision model writes a query for each image, and degoog runs it through your normal image engines next to the engines that search by image.

rank.label: Re-rank results by how they look
rank.description: The visitor's browser compares every result with the image and reorders them.

baseUrl.label: Vision model URL
baseUrl.description: Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM or any OpenAI-compatible server.

model.label: Model
model.description: It has to accept images, for example qwen3.5:4b or gemma4:e4b.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: The server sends this with every image. Keep the last sentence. It makes the model answer with a query field.

refinePrompt.label: Prompt when the visitor adds words
refinePrompt.description: The server adds this when the visitor types words next to the image. {text} becomes those words.

maxConcurrent.label: Images described at once
maxConcurrent.description: While this many are running, new image searches skip the query and say the model is busy.

rankModel.label: Ranking model
rankModel.description: A CLIP model in transformers.js ONNX format. Bigger models are more accurate, but slower to download and run. Find models lists them.

rankRevision.label: Ranking model revision
rankRevision.description: Branch, tag or commit. The default is a pinned commit of the default model. Leave it blank or pick another model to use the latest commit on main.

weakMatches.label: Results that don't look like the image

matchThreshold.label: Match threshold, in percent
matchThreshold.description: Results below this similarity count as not matching.

sameThreshold.label: Same image threshold, in percent
sameThreshold.description: How close a result's fingerprint has to be to your image to get the Same image badge. It catches resized and recompressed copies, not crops.

textWeight.label: Weight of typed words
textWeight.description: How much the words typed next to the image count when ordering results. 0 ignores them.

gpuDtype.label: WebGPU precision
gpuDtype.description: The model needs this file, for example onnx/vision_model_fp16.onnx.

wasmDtype.label: WebAssembly precision
wasmDtype.description: The model needs this file, for example onnx/vision_model_quantized.onnx.

modelHost.label: Ranking model download host
modelHost.description: This server downloads the ranking model from here once. Any host with the Hugging Face layout works, a mirror too.

runtimeHost.label: Runtime download host
runtimeHost.description: An npm CDN that serves package@version/path, such as cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm or unpkg.com.

ortVersion.label: onnxruntime-web version
ortVersion.description: Leave blank to use the version transformers.js depends on.

checksums.label: Runtime checksums
checksums.description: One file name and SHA-256 per line. The server refuses a download that doesn't match. The defaults match the default versions, so update or clear them when you change a version. The server doesn't check files missing from the list.

fieldsets.vision: Vision model, turns the image into a query
fieldsets.ranking: Ranking, runs in the visitor's browser

dtype.q8: q8, a quarter of the size

notices.noClip: No models found. Type owner/repo instead.

command.title: Image search
command.hint: Or drop or paste an image into the search bar. Add words next to it to narrow the search.
